description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for an interactive shell to communicate with the LiteLLM proxy server. It includes functions for styled prompts, command display, shell setup, command execution, and handling user input within the shell.

methods.name: styled_prompt
methods.description: Creates a styled blue box prompt for user input, handling terminal size and user input.

methods.name: show_commands
methods.description: Displays a list of available CLI commands with descriptions.

methods.name: setup_shell
methods.description: Initializes the interactive shell, shows banner and server connection info.

methods.name: handle_special_commands
methods.description: Handles commands like exit, help, and clear; returns True if command was handled.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Parses and executes user commands by invoking corresponding CLI commands.

methods.name: interactive_shell
methods.description: Runs the main loop for the interactive CLI shell, handling user input and command execution.
